content:
這是為Bilicraft伺服器製作的一個原版整合包，其中集成了提升流暢度與改善遊戲體驗的模組，以及一些光影與資源包。你也可以在該整合包的基礎上新增更多模組來豐富遊戲內容。祝你遊玩愉快！

This is a Vanilla-based modpack I created for the Bilicraft server. It integrates mods that improve game smoothness and enhance the gameplay experience, along with some shaders and resource packs. You're also welcome to add more mods to this pack to further enrich your game. Have fun!
